programme.title: The Incredible Burt Wonderstone
programme.desc: Superstar magicians Burt Wonderstone (Steve Carell) and Anton Marvelton (Steve Buscemi) have ruled the Las Vegas strip for years, raking in millions with illusions as big as Burt's growing ego. But lately the duo's greatest deception is their public friendship, while secretly they've grown to loathe each other. Facing cutthroat competition from guerilla street magician Steve Gray (Jim Carrey), whose cult following surges with each outrageous stunt, even their show looks stale. But there's still a chance Burt and Anton can save the act -- both onstage and off -- if Burt can get back in touch with what made him love magic in the first place.

programme.title: Inkheart
programme.desc: What if every time you read aloud, the story came to life? Based on Cornelia Funke's bestselling children's novel, this timeless tale of imagination and adventure centers on a young girl whose father (The Mummy's Brendan Fraser) has a secret ability to bring characters from books to life when he reads them aloud. But when a ruthless villain (The Lord of the Rings' Andy Serkis) from a rare children's fable kidnaps Meggie's father to bring others out of the boundaries of fiction, she and a disparate group of friends both real and magic embark on the kind of adventure she has only read about in books to save him and set things right. Also starring The Da Vinci Code's Paul Bettany and Oscar winners Helen Mirren and Jim Broadbent, 'Inkheart' makes all the mystery, all the danger, and all the adventure jump off the page!

programme.title: Lilya Et Rayane Ep.8: Lilya Is Sick
programme.desc: Lilya and Rayane live in Morocco with their parents Salma and Saad. Going to the market, to school, doing the cleaning or going on a picnic: every day, daily tasks turn into little adventures.

programme.title: C'Est Mathématique ! Avec Iman Ep.33: Master the different triangles: isosceles, right-angled, equilateral
programme.desc: Iman, a former maths teacher, offers primary school pupils a survival kit to help them approach secondary school with confidence. In each episode, using a fun and educational approach, he aims to make his subject clear and practical.

programme.title: Jad Et Ses Soeurs Ep.11: Brushing teeth

programme.title: Mission Héros Ep.23: Watering the garden

programme.title: Compostman Et Moi Ep.13: The Key to Spring
programme.desc: Charlie and Zach live in an apartment building with their parents. One day, a friendly monster appears at their home... His name is Compostman and he is directly connected to the planet's needs. Thanks to him, Charlie and Zach will learn everything about ecology.

programme.title: Compostman Et Moi Ep.14: Nature Has Its Networks
programme.desc: Since this morning, Zach hasn't taken his eyes off his phone. He even forgets the skateboarding lesson he promised to give Charlie and Compostman.

programme.title: Les Triplés Ep.78: Are you going to take much longer?
programme.desc: The triplets may look like angels, but they're not the last to get up to mischief... The two brothers and the sister are inseparable and as loving as they are mischievous. The adults need to be brave to channel their energy!

programme.title: Chniwla Et Boubris
programme.desc: Boubris is an introverted lizard who dreams of peace and quiet. A former musician, he fled the hustle and settled away from the world. Until the day Chniwla, a hyperactive and intrusive mosquito, disrupts his daily life.

programme.title: Chniwla Et Boubris

programme.title: Cirkus Ep.9: A sneaky attack
programme.desc: Madame Loyal the ringmistress is in a total panic when she sees the ladybirds in the big top. Has Rose found her weak spot?

programme.title: Ma Vie Avec L'Ia Ep.3: Why do social networks know us so well?
programme.desc: Théo, a teenager, questions artificial intelligence directly to try to understand it better. He wants to know what it is made of, what feeds it, and how it analyzes data.

programme.title: Les Super-Pouvoirs Du Vivant Ep.9: The water bear
programme.desc: The animal kingdom is brimming with creatures that have extraordinary powers. To reveal the incredible inventiveness of nature and the importance of protecting it, each episode takes us on a fascinating journey rich in poetry and humour.

programme.title: Mission Info

programme.title: Matière Grise
programme.desc: The magazine programme which takes the mystery out of science, encouraging us to think... without all the brain work!

programme.title: Falò

programme.title: Objectif Monde L'Hebdo

"Objectif Monde L'Hebdo", a television magazine by French-speaking editorialists, takes time to reflect and analyse through the expert insights and opinions provided by specialists. A TV5MONDE programme, jointly produced with RTS, in collaboration with its francophone partners (RTBF, Radio-Canada, France Télévisions).

programme.title: Secrets Des Profondeurs Ep.10: The legend of Sherkston Quarry
programme.desc: Sam and Mario head to Port Colborne, Ontario, to try to discover what could have caused the quarry to become flooded, a mystery that has led to innumerable hypotheses.

programme.title: La Belle Vie Ep.10: A sharing community life
programme.desc: In Rivière-à-Claude, Julien discovers an open-air cooperative set up by Antoine. Totally off-grid ten young adults live there, each participating fully in all the projects: from household tasks to creating a garden.

programme.title: Suisse En Scène
programme.desc: Interview with a key figure from the Swiss cultural scene. An opportunity to look back at their life and career, and the foundations that underpin their work.

programme.title: Rassemblance Ep.3: Johanna Tordjman (Algeria/Tunisia)
programme.desc: A French artist of Algerian and Tunisian origins, it was the death of her grandmother that triggered her artistic gesture. Johanna Tordjman had to paint in order not to forget. Drawing on photographic archives, she chose to tell, through brushstrokes, the stories of heritage, immigration and the invisible memories of contemporary France.

programme.title: Le Match Dans Le Match Ep.105: Flavio Roma
programme.desc: Flavio Roma, former AS Monaco goalkeeper and finalist of the 2004 Champions League, looks back on his career, his beginnings at Lazio, his adaptation in Monaco, his locker-room memories and his career marked by passion, challenges and charitable commitment.

programme.title: Le Téléjournal De Radio-Canada

programme.title: Magazine

programme.title: Démo De Mode Ep.2: Franck Sorbier

programme.title: Tendance Xxi Ep.16: Empreintes / Jelly Shoes / Janique Bourget / Tassels
programme.desc: Decor, tableware, furniture, lighting, jewellery... Empreintes is the Parisian concept store that celebrates French craftsmanship. programme.title: L'Épicerie

You won’t find the same-old talking heads recycling platitudes; instead thought-provoking guests to debate and explore key issues of today’s world. Using virtual reality graphics to bring subjects to life, Stephen will navigate through subjects ranging from “Prove That Climate Change Exists” to “Who Will Win the Race to Space”. Opposing views will be given opportunity to flourish and develop into a meaningful conversation. The Agenda: No nonsense talk; Challenging perceptions.
